Infomarians are professional users who are paid out of your voting to provide poll discussion content, to moderate discussions to ensure civility and respect are maintained, and to provide real help with using the system.
profile.welcomeDesc2: We work on three strikes and your commenting rights are curtailed or removed, depending on the severity of any offense. You will be warned and the issue discussed on each notification of a complaint by another user or your Infomarian.

helpUser.title: User Guide
helpUser.regValidationBody: Complete your profile (name, date of birth, Infomarian ID, bank details). To vote, make a $0.55 AUD deposit to the Pollee Inc account, then enter the small random amount we send back to your bank to validate. You'll then receive your Voter ID.
helpUser.votingBody: Each vote is a $0.55 AUD bank transaction directed to the Yes, No, or Undecided account for that poll. You can vote at any time while a poll is open (30 days) and change your vote at any time — only your latest vote counts. Junior members (12–17) can participate in discussions and sentiment polls but their vote isn't counted in the deciding total.
helpUser.discussionsBody: Every poll has a discussion board. You must accept the responsibility agreement before posting. Comments are published immediately; Infomarians moderate to keep things civil. You can edit or delete your own comments, and reply in threads.
helpUser.reputationBody: Reputation grows from verified votes, approved comments, and delegations. Other users can "Clap" your comments, giving you +3 reputation each. Reputation Levels are simply badges of honour for continued engagement and service.
helpUser.delegationBody: Adults (18+) can delegate their vote to another trusted member, either for all polls or a specific poll. Delegated votes carry the combined weight of everyone who delegated to you.
helpUser.strikesBody: If a moderator strikes through your comment, you receive a strike and lose 3 reputation. 1st strike = 24-hour commenting suspension, 2nd = 1-week suspension, 3rd = commenting rights suspended. Your voting rights are never affected. You're emailed the reason and consequence, and you can appeal from the Report menu.
helpUser.reportBody: Use the Report menu item to file an incident report to the Board, an Infomarian, or a specific user. Describe what happened and set a priority; it's routed to the right people for review.
helpUser.profileBody: Manage your name, date of birth, Infomarian ID, phone, bank details, and a 350-character biography (no external links). Your profile shows your reputation, delegations, vote history, and any conduct strikes.

helpInfomarian.title: Infomarian Guide
helpInfomarian.roleBody: Infomarians are paid professionals who guide poll discussions, keep conversations civil, and help users. You earn from each verified vote on polls you moderate and from user tips.
helpInfomarian.queueBody: The Queue and Poll Review tabs list comments and polls awaiting action. Approve content to publish it, or use Strike Through to moderate it. The Moderation item in the menu bar (Moderation Alerts) gives the same controls across all your assigned polls.
helpInfomarian.strikesBody: When you Strike Through a comment, the author receives a conduct strike and loses 3 reputation. Penalties escalate: 1st strike = 24-hour commenting suspension, 2nd strike = 1-week commenting suspension, 3rd strike = commenting rights suspended (voting rights are never affected). The user is emailed the reason, the consequence, and how to appeal.
helpInfomarian.strikeVsRemoveBody: Strike Through keeps the comment visible with a line through it and issues a strike. Remove deletes the comment entirely with no strike. Use Remove for spam/illegal content; use Strike Through for conduct violations that should be on the public record.
helpInfomarian.userSupportBody: The Support tab lets you message users and walk them through validation, voting, and delegation. Tasks let you assign work to other Infomarians (moderation, support, content).
helpInfomarian.earningsBody: You receive $0.30 AUD from each $0.55 vote on your polls, plus any tip the voter adds. Track totals in the Earnings tab.
helpInfomarian.reputationBody: Your own reputation grows with approved comments, votes, and delegations, and drops with strikes. Higher reputation unlocks priority visibility and leadership eligibility.

helpConstituency.title: Constituency Administrator Guide
helpConstituency.constituenciesBody: A Constituency is the local chapter that owns polls and Infomarians for a region. Create constituencies from the Constituencies tab, set their postcodes and state, and assign an owner who becomes its Constituency Manager.
helpConstituency.infomarianMgmtBody: Add Infomarians under the Infomarians tab by searching registered users. Their Infomarian ID is auto-generated from the Constituency + user + sequence. Set their moderation level (local, state, federal — one or more) and assigned postcodes.
helpConstituency.pollsBody: Create polls from the Admin panel, choosing the Constituency, level (local/state/federal), and voting options. New polls enter "pending" moderation and must be approved before they appear publicly. Polls run for 720 hours (30 days).
helpConstituency.modAlertsBody: The Moderation item in the menu bar lists pending posts and flagged comments across your constituency. Approve, Strike Through (issues a conduct strike and -3 reputation to the author), or Remove. Strikes trigger the 3-strikes policy: 24h, then 1-week, then permanent commenting suspension.
helpConstituency.oversightBody: The dashboard shows totals across all constituencies, infomarians, polls, and votes, plus a pending-moderation count. Use it to spot backlogs and act.
helpConstituency.bankingBody: In the Admin panel Banking tab, configure the Pollee Inc validation account and the Yes / No / Undecided vote destination accounts that vote transactions are directed to.
helpConstituency.incidentsBody: Users can file Incident Reports (Board, Infomarian, or User) from the Report menu. Review and resolve forwarded reports to keep the community safe.
